title: GetMyHotels
description: Search hotels, get live prices, and check out in chat. Guest search needs no sign-in.
summary: Search hotels, get live prices, and check out in chat. Guest search needs no sign-in.
offersHint: Search hotels, get live prices, and check out in chat. Guest search needs no sign-in. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.getmyhotels.com

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search GetMyHotels for hotels matching a query. Returns a list of results with ids that can be passed to `fetch` for full details. Provide the destination and travel dates in the query.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full record for a result id returned by `search` (a hotel) or for a booking reference (prefixed 'bk_'). Returns a document with id, title, text, url, and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: search_hotels
toolsPreview.description: Search live hotel availability for a destination and date range. Returns a price-sorted list of hotels (JSON in the text), each with a `ref` and its cheapest bookable room's `supplierRoomId`. To book: pass a room's `supplierRoomId` + the hotel `ref` to `get_checkout_quote` then `create_checkout`. For a hotel's other rooms (or a hotel not in the list), call `get_rooms`. Narrow with `keywords` (a hotel name, area, or amenities).

toolsPreview.name: get_rooms
toolsPreview.description: List the bookable rooms for ONE hotel and date range. Each room's `supplierRoomId` is what you pass to `get_checkout_quote` / `create_checkout`. Use the hotel `ref` from `search_hotels` or `search`. Call this to see all of a chosen hotel's rooms, or to refresh availability before checkout.

toolsPreview.name: get_hotel_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full property details (description, amenities, photos, policies, location) for a hotel, identified by its `ref` from `search_hotels` (or its supplierCode + supplierHotelId).

toolsPreview.name: get_checkout_quote
toolsPreview.description: Re-price a specific room live against the supplier before checkout (no booking, no charge). Use the `supplierRoomId` and price/currency from `search_hotels`. Returns the authoritative grand total, a `rateValidUntil` timestamp, and any taxes/fees.

toolsPreview.name: create_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create a secure checkout for a chosen hotel room and return a getmyhotels.com URL where the guest completes payment. This does NOT charge the card — the guest pays on the hosted page. Confirm the hotel, room, dates, and price with the user before calling. Call `get_checkout_quote` first to confirm the live price.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking
toolsPreview.description: Look up a hotel booking by its management token (sent in the confirmation email). Returns the booking status, hotel, dates, and guest details.

toolsPreview.name: list_trips
toolsPreview.description: List the signed-in user's saved trips (itineraries).

toolsPreview.name: save_trip
toolsPreview.description: Create a new saved trip (itinerary) for the signed-in user.

toolsPreview.name: add_trip_item
toolsPreview.description: Add an item (hotel, flight, activity, etc.) to a saved trip on a given day.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_bookings
toolsPreview.description: List the signed-in user's hotel bookings.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_booking
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of one of the signed-in user's bookings by its public id.

toolsPreview.name: request_booking_action_code
toolsPreview.description: Email a 6-digit verification code to the booking owner, required before cancelling or modifying a booking. Step 1 of 2 — then call `cancel_booking`/`modify_booking` with the code.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_booking
toolsPreview.description: Cancel one of the signed-in user's bookings. Requires the 6-digit `verificationCode` from `request_booking_action_code`. This may be irreversible and can trigger a refund per policy.

toolsPreview.name: modify_booking
toolsPreview.description: Change one of the signed-in user's bookings. Requires the 6-digit `verificationCode` from `request_booking_action_code`. Special-request edits always apply. A DATE change is pushed to the hotel supplier as a cancel-and-rebook at current availability, so it only works for suppliers that support amendment — for others (and when no room is available for the new dates) it returns an error asking you to cancel and rebook instead. A date change can shift the price and issue a new confirmation; the result's `supplierModifyStatus` says whether the supplier reservation was actually changed (`modified`), simulated (`simulated`), or the edit stayed local (`local_only`, e.g. special requests only). Never promise a date change went through unless `supplierModifyStatus` is `modified` or `simulated`.

toolsPreview.name: list_payment_methods
toolsPreview.description: List the signed-in user's saved payment cards (brand, last 4, expiry, default). Use the returned `publicId` with `create_one_click_checkout` to pre-select a card.

toolsPreview.name: create_one_click_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create a checkout for the signed-in user with a saved card pre-selected, and return a getmyhotels.com URL where they confirm + pay in one click. Does NOT charge the card — the user confirms on the hosted page. Get the `savedPaymentMethodPublicId` from `list_payment_methods`. Confirm the hotel, room, dates, and price with the user first.
